Drilling progress up to April 2026 achieved 103% of target with 11% YoY growth, while 2D/3D seismic survey achieved 100% of target.
FD deposits rose to ₹1,050 Cr from ₹970 Cr, generating ₹10.05 Cr more interest income year on year.
Trade receivable stood at 5.17 months of sales in Q1FY27 versus 5.33 months a year earlier.
Dues over six months were ₹259.97 Cr of the ₹978.00 Cr total debtors at 30.06.2026.
Company operates as a single reportable segment: Consultancy services.
CMPDI achieved 102% of its FY27 drilling target of 12.00 lakh m with 5.31 lakh m drilled up to Sep' 2026, growing 12% YoY.

timeline.summary: CMPDI submitted its FY26 audited standalone financial results and recommended a final dividend of ₹1.06 per share on April 21, 2026.
CMPDI reported FY26 drilling achievement at 105% of target and approved ₹5.43 Cr capex for the Nawatala Devigarh REE block.
Q4FY26 results (standalone): revenue ₹826.88 Cr, net profit ₹187.82 Cr.
CMPDI signed a 5-year MoU with MECL on 14.05.2026 for mineral exploration services.
CMPDI reconstituted its board, approved a 3-year consultancy MoU renewal with NTPC Mining, and appointed its statutory auditor as tax auditor for FY25-26 on May 20, 2026.
CMPDI's Q1FY27 presentation showed revenue up 18% to ₹481.37 Cr and PAT up 54% to ₹116.27 Cr, with operating margin at 28.56%.
Q2FY27 results (standalone): revenue ₹593.31 Cr, net profit ₹194.84 Cr.
CMPDI drilling targets exceeded in Q2FY27
CMPDI released its corporate presentation for the results of the quarter and half-year ended 30 September 2026.
